mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT tb_action.action FROM tb_action WHERE tb_action.application_id = #{applicationId} AND tb_action.`status` = 0
select id from tb_organization tbo where tbo.full_path like concat((select full_path from tb_organization tbo2 where tbo2.id = #{organizationId}), '%')
select id, code, name, type_id, parent_id, short_name, full_path_name, administrative_area, level, sort, remark, status, gmt_created, full_path, gmt_modified from tb_organization where id = #{id}
